messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: fitMeasures by group?
parts:
On 03/04/2015 08:27 PM, Diana Zavala Rojas wrote:
> Hello,
>
> Is it possible to get fit measures *by group* from a lavaan object?

> pretty much what LISREL gives in a multi-group SEM model, Root Mean
> Square Residual (RMR); Standardized RMR; Goodness of Fit Index (GFI)...
>
> I am only able to see the Chi-square for each group.

No, not at the moment. That would only be useful if you dot not have any
across-groups constraints (like equal factor loadings). In other words,
each group has a separate set of parameters. In these cases, you can
simply fit a model for each group separately, and look at the fit measures.

Yves.
